title: 第562章 想要证据系统滚出来干活第561章 我是来辅佐你当大周女帝的
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
第562章想要证据？系统滚出来干活！
“你说你是来干什么的？！”
面对李青幽难以置信的追问。
沈浪则是脸不红，心不跳地旧事重提。
“我说，我此番来儒道世界，就是为了帮助你成为大周女帝的！”
“毕竟，在我看来，儒道世界的气运已尽，理应改朝换代了！”
得到准确的答复后。
李青幽只觉得刚才给沈浪吃的那颗丹药，还不如去喂狗！
至少狗吃了之后，绝对不会说出如此疯癫的话语。
所以，觉得沈浪就是条疯狗的李青幽，脸色瞬间冷若寒霜，不带一丝情感道：
“我就是一个可怜的女人，不想做什么大周女帝，你还是免开尊口吧！”
说完。
李青幽抱着妞妞，坐在椅子上，闭上了眼。
沈浪见状，缓缓眯起眼：“你不相信我说的？”
李青幽不说话，权当没有听到！
反倒是妞妞小声的提醒道：“叔叔，别说了，娘亲生气了！”
“呵~”
沈浪听到妞妞这话，不由得笑了。
“她不是生气，她只是不相信本相的本事，到底有多大罢了！”
“妞妞，你想不想拜本相为师，我可以传你五年高考，三年模拟证道之法！”

“哈？！！”
妞妞听到沈浪这话，一张可爱的小脸上浮现出了呆萌的表情。
显然，五年高考，三年模拟的证道之法，她并没有听过！
但沈浪的自我介绍，她可是知道这意味着什么的。
所以，哪怕妞妞年纪不是很大。
但作为崔勇女儿的她，还是忍不住的惊呼出声。
“叔叔，您也是宰相大人吗？！”
“可我爸爸说，女子无才便是德，我也可以学习的吗？”
沈浪看着妞妞那副天真的小脸，笑着点了点头。
毕竟，他很清楚妞妞就是李青幽的一切！
拿下了妞妞，李青幽这辈子都翻不出他的五指山！
content_en:
Chapter 562: Want evidence? Get the system out of work!
"What did you say you were here for?!"
Faced with Li Qingyou's incredible questioning.
Shen Lang, on the other hand, didn't blush and brought up the old things again without a beating heart.
"I said, I came to the world of Confucianism and Taoism this time just to help you become the Empress of the Great Zhou Dynasty!"
"After all, in my opinion, the fate of the Confucian and Taoist world has expired, and it is time for a change of dynasty!"
After getting an accurate answer.
Li Qingyou just felt that the pill he gave Shen Lang just now might as well be fed to the dog!
At least a dog would never say such crazy things after eating it.
Therefore, Li Qingyou, who felt that Shen Lang was a mad dog, immediately turned as cold as ice and said without any emotion:
"I'm just a poor woman. If I don't want to be the Empress of Zhou, you'd better stop talking!"
Finished.
Li Qingyou hugged Niu Niu, sat on the chair, and closed her eyes.
Seeing this, Shen Lang slowly narrowed his eyes: "You don't believe what I said?"
Li Qingyou didn't speak, so he pretended he didn't hear it!
Instead, Niu Niu reminded her in a low voice: "Uncle, stop talking, mother is angry!"
"Ha~"
Shen Lang couldn't help but laugh when he heard Niu Niu's words.
"She's not angry, she just doesn't believe in her true abilities and how big they are!"
"Niuniu, do you want to become your teacher? I can teach you the method of five years of college entrance examination and three years of simulated enlightenment!"
"Huh?!!"
When Niu Niu heard Shen Lang's words, a cute expression appeared on her cute little face.
Obviously, after five years of college entrance examination and three years of simulated enlightenment, she has never heard of it!
But Shen Lang's self-introduction, she knew what it meant.
Therefore, even if Niu Niu is not very old.
But as Cui Yong's daughter, she couldn't help but exclaimed.
"Uncle, are you also the Prime Minister?!"
"But my father said that it is virtue for a woman not to have talent. Can I learn from it?"
Shen Lang looked at Niu Niu's innocent little face, smiled and nodded.
After all, he knew very well that Niu Niu was everything to Li Qingyou!
After taking down Niuniu, Li Qingyou will never be able to climb out of his Wuzhishan in this life!
